requirements.description: User prefers energy class D or better, so the filter includes D and all higher classes (A1-A4, B, C).

The user explicitly requires at least 115 sqm of gross floor area. The 15-person capacity is not converted into an area filter, since no verified gross-property-area threshold was supplied by the RegulatoryAgent. The energy class preference (D or better) and the Turin location are outside the REFERENCE COLUMNS and are handled by other agents.
